messages:
eli: FYI opened a small PR to harmonize the compatibility matrix across model cards and add an embeddings note for multi-vector outputs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612

maria: Nice. Which cards are touched?

eli: Polaris13b, Nebula3b, and a new section in the embeddings guide about multi-vector models (how we shard and the embedding_dim semantics).

kevin: Can you call out which variants may return multiple vectors (and why) so SDKs can handle it? We should show a tiny client-side check.

eli: Added a short paragraph and snippet showing how to detect list outputs vs flat arrays. Snippet:
```
# python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
r = c.embed("A short sentence", model="nebula3b:embed-sharded")
vec = r.data[0]
if isinstance(vec, list) and isinstance(vec[0], list):
    # multi-vector output
    dims = [len(v) for v in vec]
    print("Multi-vector shards:", dims)
else:
    print("Single vector length:", len(vec))
```

ara: Good. Also add a one-line note about how to recombine shards (concatenate) and link to the embedding sharding guide.

eli: Done, linked to /docs/embeddings/sharding and added a small recombine example.

samir: Bench question  did you add perf numbers for the embed-sharded variant? Customers ask about throughput when models return multiple vectors.

eli: Added med/p95 per-request times for a 128-token prepro + 1-prompt embed: single-vector: med 35ms p95 80ms; sharded 2x: med 62ms p95 140ms. Gist with raw CSV: https://gist.github.com/eli/embed-shard-612

kevin: Please include a one-line Dedicated migration note: pinned pools may have kernel/hardware constraints that affect sharded model placement. Recommend verifying pool labels.

eli: Added Dedicated checklist and a Private deployment note about ensuring the shard allocator service is running on control plane.

maria: Small style nit: headings should be sentence case and keep code blocks short. Also fix the dead cross-link from /models/nebula -> /catalog/nebula3b.

eli: Updated heading casing and fixed the anchor. Squashed commits and requested reviewers.

docs-bot: New PR opened by eli: #612  reviewers requested: @maria @kevin @ara @samir
